sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1. Heard learned advocate for the applicant.
Noticing the limited prayer sought for in the present application, the present application is taken up for hearing at admission stage without issuance of notice upon the respondents.
2. Present application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act read with Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act praying for condonation of delay of 17 days caused in preferring the appeal.

3. Learned advocate for the applicant- original claimant has mainly relied upon the relevant dates referred to in para 3 of the application and has urged this Court that because of the circumstances narrated in the para 3, the appeal could not be presented within the prescribed period of limitation.
He has further urged that looking to the benevolent piece of legislation, the applicant intends to present her case for enhancement of the compensation.
He has therefore, urged NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/4659/2025 ORDER DATED: 08/09/2025 undefined this Court to take liberal view and condone the delay.

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid explanation offered by the learned advocate for the applicant, in light of the averments made in the application stated on oath, this Court is inclined to accept the aforesaid explanation to be sufficient cause which prevented the applicant to present her appeal within stipulated period of limitation.
Hence, delay of 17 days caused in preferring the appeal is hereby condoned.
